alt: A formal letter from the California Department of Health Care Services dated February 5, 2026, confirming the acceptance of Narcotic Treatment Program Complaint Number 26-30 regarding Wester Pacific in Lancaster, CA.
full_text: State of California—Health and Human Services Agency, Department of Health Care Services. Michelle Baass, Director. Gavin Newsom, Governor. February 5, 2026. Nicolas Hernandez. Dear Mr. Hernandez: NARCOTIC TREATMENT PROGRAM COMPLAINT NUMBER 26-30. This letter is in response to information reported to the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS), Counselor & Medication Assisted Treatment (CMAT) Section, on February 5, 2026, regarding Wester Pacific located at 45335 Sierra Hwy, Lancaster, CA. We have accepted the information as the basis for a formal complaint. The complaint has been assigned number 26-30. Please reference this number when corresponding with this office. An investigation of the complaint will be conducted and we may need to contact you for further information once the investigation begins. Please be advised, the Department is unable to provide any information regarding the investigation until it has concluded. If you have any questions, concerns or additional information that you feel may be helpful to the investigation, please contact your assigned analyst at (916) 938-4044 or by e-mail at @dhcs.ca.gov. Sincerely, Analyst, Counselor & Medication Assisted Treatment Section, Licensing and Certification Division. Licensing and Certification Division, Counselor & Medication Assisted Treatment Section, MS 2603, P.O. Box 997413, Sacramento, CA 95899-7413, (916) 322-6682, Division Homepage: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/provgovpart/Pages/Licensing_and_Certification_Division.aspx
